tools.name: fs.read
tools.summary: Read any repository file except named denials (.pi/, .git/, credential-shaped paths).

tools.name: fs.write
tools.summary: Write files only inside the handoff's declared in-scope paths; every refusal is recorded.

tools.name: shell.run
tools.summary: Run an npm script by name from the root manifest, only when the profile allowlists it.

tools.name: git.diff
tools.summary: Read-only diff summary of working-tree changes.

tools.name: git.commit
tools.summary: Commit staged changes on the working branch with a supplied message; staging is the builder's own action.

tools.name: kit.validate
tools.summary: Validate vict.builder.* documents against their versioned schemas.

tools.name: kit.generate
tools.summary: Regenerate the committed stable layer (catalog, base pack, renderings).

absent.name: git.push
absent.reason: not a kit tool; the owner pushes (architecture §3.5)

absent.name: control.validate / control.propose / control.simulate / control.inspect / control.activateDev
absent.reason: optional VICT control-tool bindings omitted in this kit build (WP-3 option exercised); no control authority is available through the kit

absent.name: publish / production activation / approval / role change / secret access
absent.reason: absent from every builder profile; attempts are escalation-shaped stop conditions
